responsibility: Implements the M32C target’s C-family pragma handling and target-specific address-space registration. It parses #pragma GCC memregs to update the backend’s configurable memreg register set before any function declarations, re-running conditional register-usage setup, and parses #pragma ADDRESS to record fixed-address variable placements for later backend use. It also registers the __far qualifier/address space, mapping it to the real far address space on A16 targets and to a no-op generic space on full 24-bit M32C targets.
